subject: 开封繁塔 · 现存三层主体与小塔
author: Windmemories
source_note: Windmemories于2023年拍摄完整现塔，2025年正面底层近照补核门券；已核对三层主塔与后世小塔。
prompt: Make a careful fine-line museum plate of the EXISTING truncated Fan/Po Pagoda at Kaifeng, using photo2 for overall three-storey mass and small top stump, photo3 for facade and lower door detail. Image1 is Longmen STYLE ONLY. This is a broad SIX-SIDED brick tower, with EXACTLY THREE massive surviving storeys, stepped inward upward, wide horizontal projecting brick cornice bands and short sloping roof belts between tiers. The first storey is much taller than the other two. At top is the actual much smaller later tapering mound and stubby worn cylindrical little tower, NOT a full-height replacement pagoda. Keep whole shape and the tiny crown as observed; do not restore the lost original upper stories. Use near-frontal two-face view matching actual front photo3, large arched opening low on front facade, arch opening second level, small openings upper level. Numerous relief Buddha bricks are reduced to SELECTED scattered rectangular framed motifs, never dense wallpaper. Remove surrounding white wall, fence, trees, signs and people. Monument base may gently fade into white where partly obscured in references, no invented grand podium. Clean thin black outlines on white, not an edge-filter texture. No filled dark doorways, gray shading or crosshatching. Landscape1536x1024, entire broad tower and small top inside10%white margins, no captions or text.

site_recommendation.name: 开封繁塔
site_recommendation.lede: 宽大的六角塔身只留下三层，却仍保有重叠的砖雕与佛龛。繁塔不完整的轮廓，记录着宋塔营建之后的拆毁与修补。
facts: 繁塔建于北宋开宝七年（974），现存高大的下部三层。
六角塔身遍布佛像砖与仿木构细部，顶部另有后世改筑的小塔。
图版按现状画三层主体与顶部残存小塔，不将原九层复原为完整塔身。
site_recommendation.yearNote: 974为宋代主体创建年；顶部小塔和修补细部不使用此年断代。
